fullPassage: Tree transplant shock is a condition that occurs when a tree undergoes stress or trauma after being moved to a new location. Symptoms of tree transplant shock include slower growth, which can potentially lead to death. Removed from its original location, a young tree can be expected to retain only about 15% of its root system. This reduces its ability to absorb water and nutrients from the soil. There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. Better suited to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly. Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become firmly established in its new location.

questions.passage: Tree transplant shock is a condition that occurs when a tree undergoes stress or trauma after being moved to a new location. Symptoms of tree transplant shock include slower growth, which can potentially lead to death. Removed from its original location, a young tree can be expected to retain only about 15% of its root system. This reduces its ability to absorb water and nutrients from the soil. There are, however, ways to deal with this, such as transplanting only trees that are native to the region. Better suited to deal with the local climate and soils, these trees will develop new roots more quickly. Both before and after the transplant, be sure to provide the tree with plenty of water. Once successfully transplanted, the tree will require regular watering until it has become <u>firmly established</u> in its new location.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 firmly established가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
firmly established는 나무가 새 위치에 '단단히 자리 잡은' 상태로, 뿌리를 튼튼히 내려 새 환경에 완전히 정착했다는 뜻이에요.

③ having produced its very first flowers(첫 꽃을 피운): 꽃은 다루지 않음
④ having been moved back to its original place(원래 자리로 다시 옮겨진): 되돌아가는 내용이 아님
det.tip: firmly established = 뿌리를 튼튼히 내려 새 흙에 완전히 정착함
